purpose: Source-led exploration of Sanatan / Hindu sacred narratives: episodes, characters, themes, versions, and living retellings. Dedicated niches cover philosophy, individual texts, sectarian traditions, temple practice, and mythological animation in greater depth.
editorial_principles: Name the text, translation, performance, place, or community behind each episode; do not collapse variants into one definitive version.
Distinguish what a sacred narrative says, what practitioners believe, and what independent historical evidence supports.
Use mythology as a literary or academic category with care; do not imply that a living faith is false.
Avoid pseudo-archaeological or ancient-technology claims without relevant primary evidence and expert review.
Describe contested interpretations fairly and obtain community voices or specialist review when a living practice is central.
